extension.description: VS Code helpers for JellyFrame app packages.

command.debugExternal: JellyFrame: Debug App In External Window
menu.label: JellyFrame
viewContainer.title: JellyFrame
configuration.title: JellyFrame
configuration.repoRoot: Optional JellyFrame repository root. Leave empty when running the extension from this repository.
configuration.buildDir: Optional desktop runtime directory. Leave empty to prefer build/desktop-release/Release, then build/desktop-debug/Debug.
configuration.openCaptureAfterRun: Open a generated capture after preview or frame-script execution.
configuration.pythonPath: Python executable used to run tools/jellyframe_cli.py.
configuration.defaultTarget: Default target preset passed to JellyFrame CLI commands.
configuration.fontBudget: Default glyph budget passed to font resource checks.
configuration.deviceProvider: Absolute path to the Device OS provider executable. Leave empty until a supported developer image provider is installed.
configuration.deviceManifest: Optional Developer Image manifest used to verify discovered device identity.
